item.title: Cryptography 10: Learning With Errors — Lattice-Based Hardness and Variants
item.description: An introduction to the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem, its lattice structure, hardness reduction from BDD and SVP, and its computational variants: DLWE and ss-LWE.
